title: Quick German Dumplings
description: A simple recipe for German-style dumplings made with a quick dough. These dumplings are perfect as a side dish or light meal.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the flour and salt.
Gradually add in the warm water and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until smooth.
Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil.
Divide the dough into 8-10 equal pieces.
Roll each piece into a ball and then flatten slightly into a disk shape.
Cook the dumplings in the boiling water for 10-12 minutes, or until they float to the surface.
Remove the dumplings from the water with a slotted spoon and serve hot.
